rest_write_binary_sensor.description: Cyclically sends a value for the channel of a binary sensor entity to the backend via REST. Values sent via REST write are not reflected by the backend and thus not visible in Home Assistant.

update_cycle.description: Cycle in which a new request will be sent. This is necessary because FEMS resets REST values after 60 seconds by default. Use 0 for a single REST call only.
